output.reasoning: The student describes joining the two trapezoids along a side of length 1 with the two wide sides lying along the same boundary. In a triangular grid, the acute base angles of the trapezoid are 60°, so two wide bases cannot be collinear when joined along a side of length 1 (only a 60° acute angle and a 120° obtuse angle can form a straight 180° boundary). Furthermore, shifting the trapezoids along their 2-unit bases with a 1-unit overlap results in an 8-sided figure, not a 6-sided figure.
